description: This Java class 'XmlExampleSerializer' serializes 'Example' objects into XML format, handling different types of examples such as ObjectExample and ArrayExample, and managing XML element attributes, namespaces, and nested structures.

classes.name: XmlExampleSerializer
classes.description: A class for serializing 'Example' objects into XML format, supporting nested objects and arrays, with namespace and attribute handling.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an 'Example' object into an XML string.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Recursively writes an 'Example' object to an XMLStreamWriter, handling different types and nested structures.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of an 'Example' object.
